event.title: InsForge added support for custom SMTP and an auth email template editor
event.summary: InsForge now supports custom SMTP and an auth email template editor.

sourcePreview.title: InsForge now supports custom SMTP and an auth email template editor. Bring your own SES, Resend, Postmark, Mailgun, or self-hosted Postfix, and start customizing and sending emails to your users exactly the way you want.
